description.value: Tacofino is a BC-born west coast Mexican-inspired chain that started as a food truck in Tofino and has grown into a beloved multi-location brand known for burritos, tacos, and casual beach-food vibes. The Yaletown outpost sits in one of Vancouver's most bikeable and walkable neighbourhoods, steps from the seawall. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a relaxed spot to refuel mid-ride.
